note: Do not instantiate directly; use itasca.mpoint.node module functions.

methods.name: extra
methods.description: Get the mesh point extra data in the given slot.

methods.name: force_unbal
methods.description: Get the mesh point mesh point unbalance force (vector).

methods.name: force_unbal_x
methods.description: Get the x-component of the mesh point mesh point unbalance force.

methods.name: force_unbal_y
methods.description: Get the y-component of the mesh point mesh point unbalance force.

methods.name: force_unbal_z
methods.description: Get the z-component of the mesh point mesh point unbalance force.

methods.name: grav_mass
methods.description: Get the mesh point gravitational mass.

methods.name: group
methods.description: Get the mesh point group name in a given slot.

methods.name: group_remove
methods.signature: meshpoint.group_remove(group_name: str or int[, slot: str or int]) -> bool
methods.description: Remove from the given group from all group slots of the mesh point. One argument of type string, giving the group name, is required. The return value is a bool which is True if the group was removed from any slot, otherwise False.

methods.name: groups
methods.description: Get a dictionary describing which groups this mesh point is part of. The keys of the dictionary are the slot names and the values are the group names.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Get the mesh point id.

methods.name: in_group
methods.signature: meshpoint.in_group(group_name: str or int[, slot: str or int]) -> bool
methods.description: Test if the mesh point is part of a given group. If the optional argument slot is given, only that slot is searched. Otherwise, all group slots are searched.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Get the mesh point index.

methods.name: pos
methods.description: Get the mesh point mesh point position (vector).

methods.name: pos_x
methods.description: Get the x-component of the mesh point mesh point position.

methods.name: pos_y
methods.description: Get the y-component of the mesh point mesh point position.

methods.name: pos_z
methods.description: Get the z-component of the mesh point mesh point position.

methods.name: radius
methods.description: Get the mesh point radius.

methods.name: set_extra
methods.description: Set the mesh point extra data in the given slot.

methods.name: set_group
methods.signature: meshpoint.set_group(group_name: str or int[, slot: str or int]) -> None
methods.description: Set the mesh point group name in a given slot.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Returns True if this mesh point is live.

methods.name: velocity
methods.description: Get the mesh point mesh point velocity (vector).

methods.name: velocity_x
methods.description: Get the x-component of the mesh point mesh point velocity.

methods.name: velocity_y
methods.description: Get the y-component of the mesh point mesh point velocity.

methods.name: velocity_z
methods.description: Get the z-component of the mesh point mesh point velocity.
